function: Excluded for system: over-the-air FL aggregation (area 7) over a single-antenna OTFS link without RIS; p. 3 eqs. (10) and (12) use NM x 1 symbol vectors, no antenna array.
notes: Reason system. The paper proposes OTA computation FL over OTFS (p. 1: "we propose an over-the-air (OTA) computation-based FL scheme suitable for time-varying wireless channels"). The problem solved is the OTA aggregation itself (ZF precoder with optimal power allocation, EKF tracking of the delay-Doppler channel), so the area would be 7, which takes precedence over area 4; the single-antenna exemption of OTFS and NTN works (areas 4 and 6) therefore does not apply. The link is single-antenna and has no RIS: the system model is a CS and K IoT devices (p. 2), the delay-Doppler input-output is ydd = sum_k Hdd,k sdd,k with sdd,k in C^(NM x 1) (p. 3, eqs. 10 and 12), and no antenna array, beamformer or RIS appears anywhere in the design or the simulation (p. 5). Multiple antennas at the server and intelligent reflecting surfaces are mentioned only in related work [9] and [8] (p. 1). Learning is only the FedAvg classifier on 10,000 synthetic MATLAB digit images (p. 5); the ZF precoder, the power allocation and the EKF are not learned, but OTA FL passes the no_learning check by rule. Quantitative simulation results exist (p. 5, Fig. 2), so the results check is not the reason. Reviewer: confirm the reading that the OTFS exemption follows the area (4 and 6) and not the waveform; if the exemption is read by waveform, the work would be included as area 7.
